mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines > 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with labor market stress
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases > 2% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth is negative.
